description_en: Queries a list of media fingerprint analysis jobs
name: QueryDNAJobList

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the media fingerprint analysis jobs that you want to query. We recommend that you query at most 10 jobs at a time. Separate multiple job IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 需要查询的DNA作业ID列表。一次最多建议查询10个，用半角逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: job_ids

JobList.description_en: The queried media fingerprint analysis jobs

items.description_en: The queried media fingerprint analysis job

Config.description_en: The configurations of the media fingerprint analysis job

CreationTime.description_en: The time when the job was created

DBId.description_en: The ID of the media fingerprint library

DNAResult.description_en: The URL of the media fingerprint analysis result

FinishTime.description_en: The time when the job was complete

Input.description_en: The details of the input file

Media.description_en:
The input file. The file can be an OSS object or a media asset. The path of an OSS object can be in one of the following formats:

1. oss\://bucket/object

2. http(s)://bucket.oss-[regionId].aliyuncs.com/object

In the preceding paths, bucket indicates an OSS bucket that resides in the same region as the current project, and object indicates the path of the object in the bucket
Media.description_zh:
输入文件信息，支持OSS地址和媒资ID两种。
OSS地址规则为

1、oss://bucket/object

2、http(s)://bucket.oss-[regionId].aliyuncs.com/object

其中bucket为和当前项目处于同一区域的oss bucket名称，object为文件路径

Type.description_en:
The type of the input file. Valid values:

OSS: Object Storage Service (OSS) object.

Media: media asset
Type.description_zh:
输入文件类型，取值：
OSS：OSS文件地址
Media：媒资ID

PrimaryKey.description_en: The primary key of the video. You must make sure that each primary key is unique
PrimaryKey.description_zh: 唯一的视频主键，唯一性由用户保证

Status.description_en:
The job state. Valid values:

Queuing: The job is waiting in the queue.

Analysing: The job is in progress.

Success: The job is successful.

Fail: The job failed
Status.description_zh:
作业状态，可取值：

Queuing：排队中。
Analysing：分析中。
Success：成功。
Fail：失败
